name: darkhub-suite
description: High-performance modular Windows utility suite for gamers and power users.
author: DarkHub Team

scripts.build:native: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe /target:exe /platform:x64 /optimize+ /out:electron\services\DarkHub.LatencyEngine.exe electron\services\DarkHub.LatencyEngine.cs; & C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe /target:exe /platform:x64 /optimize+ /out:electron\services\DarkHub.FrameLimiter.exe electron\services\DarkHub.FrameLimiter.cs; & C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe /target:exe /platform:x64 /optimize+ /out:electron\services\DarkHub.ClickEngine.exe electron\services\DarkHub.ClickEngine.cs; & C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe /target:exe /platform:x64 /optimize+ /out:electron\services\DarkHub.SensorDaemon.exe electron\services\DarkHub.SensorDaemon.cs; & C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe /target:exe /platform:x64 /optimize+ /out:electron\services\DarkHub.DiskScan.exe electron\services\DarkHub.DiskScan.cs; & C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe /target:exe /platform:x64 /optimize+ /out:electron\services\hwsensors\DarkHub.HwSensors.exe /r:electron\services\hwsensors\LibreHardwareMonitorLib.dll /r:System.Management.dll electron\services\hwsensors\DarkHub.HwSensors.cs; & C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe /target:exe /platform:anycpu /optimize+ /out:electron\services\DarkHub.VaultBridgeHost.exe electron\services\DarkHub.VaultBridgeHost.cs; & C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe /target:exe /platform:anycpu /optimize+ /r:System.Web.Extensions.dll /out:electron\services\DarkHub.Mcp.exe electron\services\DarkHub.Mcp.cs; & C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe /target:exe /platform:anycpu /optimize+ /out:electron\services\DarkHub.HotkeyWatch.exe electron\services\DarkHub.HotkeyWatch.cs"
scripts.build:pacer: set "RUSTFLAGS=-C target-feature=+crt-static" && cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --manifest-path native_pacer/Cargo.toml --lib && cargo build --release --target i686-pc-windows-msvc --manifest-path native_pacer/Cargo.toml --lib --bins && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Copy-Item native_pacer/target/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release/DarkHub_PacerHook.dll electron/services/DarkHub.PacerHook.x64.dll -Force; Copy-Item native_pacer/target/i686-pc-windows-msvc/release/DarkHub_PacerHook.dll electron/services/DarkHub.PacerHook.x86.dll -Force; Copy-Item native_pacer/target/i686-pc-windows-msvc/release/DarkHub_PacerInject.exe electron/services/DarkHub.PacerInject.x86.exe -Force"
scripts.build:gpubench: bash native_gpubench/build-shaders.sh && set "RUSTFLAGS=-C target-feature=+crt-static" && cargo build --release --manifest-path native_gpubench/Cargo.toml && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Copy-Item native_gpubench/target/release/DarkHub_GpuBench.exe electron/services/DarkHub.GpuBench.exe -Force"
scripts.build:disk: set "RUSTFLAGS=-C target-feature=+crt-static" && cargo build --release --manifest-path native_disk/Cargo.toml && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Copy-Item native_disk/target/release/DarkHub_DiskRescue.exe electron/services/DarkHub.DiskRescue.exe -Force"
scripts.build:cleaner: set "RUSTFLAGS=-C target-feature=+crt-static" && cargo build --release --manifest-path native_cleaner/Cargo.toml && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Copy-Item native_cleaner/target/release/DarkHub_Cleaner.exe electron/services/DarkHub.Cleaner.exe -Force"
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:pacer && npm run build:disk && npm run build:cleaner && npm run build:upscaler && npm run build:libreoffice && npm run build:imagetools && npm run build:renderer && npm run integrity && electron-builder
